title: Design System: Forge Delivery Dataset Review Assignments

breakpoints.name: dataset-row-container
breakpoints.purpose: Dataset information spans the first row; Reviewer and state share the second.

breakpoints.name: assignment-heading-and-tabs
breakpoints.purpose: Wrapping assignment heading and horizontally scrollable editor tabs.

components.name: Dataset Assignment Row
components.description: Static specimen of the shared confirmation/edit row. Native selects remain editable; saving, membership changes and validation require the application runtime. Host theme variables stay live-bound; base Forge fallbacks are not a Postman-variant preview.
components.html:
示例数据集生产任务 · 12 项

处理状态仅用于本交付单的工作安排；Repair 不会自动运行返工，状态调整不会更改 Item 审核结论。
components.css: .ds-assignment{container-type:inline-size;min-width:0;color:var(--forge-text,#272a25);font-family:var(--forge-font,"Helvetica Neue",Helvetica,"PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif)}.ds-assignment-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,160px) minmax(0,140px);gap:16px;align-items:center;padding:0 0 14px}.ds-assignment-name{min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-assignment-name strong{display:block;font-size:13px;line-height:20px;font-weight:500}.ds-assignment-name>span{display:block;margin-top:4px;font-size:12px;line-height:18px;color:var(--forge-muted,#666b61)}.ds-assignment-row>label{min-width:0;font-size:12px;color:var(--forge-muted,#666b61)}.ds-assignment-row>label>span{display:block;margin-bottom:6px}.ds-required{color:var(--forge-accent,#c44318)}.ds-assignment select{min-width:0;width:100%;max-width:100%;height:36px;border:1px solid var(--forge-control-border,#c9ccc4);border-radius:6px;background:var(--forge-panel,#fff);color:var(--forge-text,#272a25);font-family:inherit;font-size:13px;line-height:20px;padding:7px 10px;text-overflow:ellipsis}.ds-assignment select:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--forge-accent,#c44318);outline-offset:2px}.ds-assignment select:disabled{color:var(--forge-muted,#666b61);cursor:not-allowed;background:var(--forge-subtle,#f6f6f3)}.ds-assignment-help{font-size:12px;line-height:18px;color:var(--forge-muted,#666b61);margin:6px 0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}@container(max-width:520px){.ds-assignment-row{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:12px}.ds-assignment-name{grid-column:1/-1}}@media(max-width:600px),(pointer:coarse){.ds-assignment select{height:44px}}@media(pointer:coarse){.ds-assignment select{font-size:16px;min-height:44px}}

components.name: Saved Dataset Review State
components.description: Non-interactive saved workflow labels. Pending and Repair are warning, reviewing is normal text, paused and unassigned are muted. Labels do not assert Item approval or launch production work.
components.html: 待审核审核中待返工 · Repair已暂停待分配

narrative.overview: Extend the incumbent delivery workflow with one responsible Reviewer per dataset. Responsibility belongs to this sheet; it is separate from member roles, Item review conclusions and production execution. This feature-scoped source record does not replace the global or Postman-variant design system.
keyCharacteristics: One dataset row, one Reviewer and one processing state.
Shared assignment controls in confirmation and existing-sheet editing.
Explicit save, permission, provenance and local-demo boundaries.
dos: Do keep dataset responsibility separate from sheet/global roles and Item conclusions.
Do preserve source identity, visible assignment coverage and explicit commit behavior.
Do retain the current local-demo and permission boundaries.
donts: Don't imply Repair executes work or approves/rejects Items.
Don't treat source and automated checks as whole-surface visual or accessibility certification.
